At Magnolia State Construction, our custom cabinets are designed with your space, style, and storage needs in mind. Whether you’re upgrading a kitchen, organizing a walk-in closet, or building a more functional laundry room, we create cabinetry solutions that fit your vision and dimensions. Every cabinet is built from quality materials and crafted with precision, ensuring beauty and functionality that lasts for years to come.

We offer fully customized home cabinetry for kitchens, bathrooms, closets, and beyond. From soft-close drawers and pull-out shelving to built-in closet systems with drawers and hanging space, we make it easy to organize your home without sacrificing style.

We also provide custom cabinet solutions for commercial spaces including offices, medical buildings, salons, retail shops, and more. Whether it’s a front-desk buildout, staff kitchenette, or storage cabinetry with drawers and compartments, we design for both functionality and durability. With Magnolia State Construction, you’ll get clean, professional results that elevate your space and meet your day-to-day operational needs.
